## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why this change belongs in the project.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.

## Permissions, privacy, and provenance

Describe any change to permissions, data handling, native APIs, dependencies, or distributed assets. Disclose materially AI-assisted code or assets and how their provenance was reviewed. Write “None” when this section is not applicable.
